# DefectAware_CompactModel

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A physics-based compact model for ferroelectric devices that accounts for material defects to predict device behavior accurately. Enables realistic simulation of ferroelectric synapses, improving the fidelity of neuromorphic circuit design and optimization.
